excluded_reporting_ramps.reason: The Embarcadero on-ramp merges beyond the corridor analysis endpoint.

assumptions: Simulation time 00:15 corresponds to observed time 07:00 after a 15-minute warmup.
PeMS total five-minute station flow is converted to vehicles per hour by multiplying by 12.
Mainline entry demand uses station 402370; measured Mathilda off-ramp demand is removed from the through flow.
Measured Mathilda, Moffett, and San Antonio northbound on-ramp flows are injected on visually audited SUMO edges.
Observed PeMS speed is a validation target, not a commanded vehicle speed.
The mainline route passes through ordered detector-matched checkpoints so shortest-path routing cannot leave US-101 for a ramp shortcut.

Any modeled passenger vehicle using a Santa Clara US-101/SR-85 express lane during weekday tolling hours is assumed to carry a valid FasTrak tag and pay the applicable toll; tag ownership and toll choice are not simulated.
Human behavior uses SUMO's stochastic Krauss following model and default lane-changing model.

estimated_entrance_mappings.name: Unmeasured pre-401998 group
estimated_entrance_mappings.basis: Rounded calibration net residual; gross entry/exit volumes unknown.

estimated_entrance_mappings.name: Unmeasured GP share of pre-401507 group
estimated_entrance_mappings.basis: Half of the 2000 veh/h group on each connector is a calibration allocation hypothesis.

estimated_entrance_mappings.name: Unmeasured express share of pre-401507 group
estimated_entrance_mappings.basis: Half of the 2000 veh/h group on each connector is a calibration allocation hypothesis; express passengers assumed eligible/toll-paying.

additional_assumptions: Two missing-entrance groups use assumed constant flow; individual counts are unknown.
4% truck proxy uses 2024 annual both-direction shares near SR-237/SR-85; morning directional share is unknown.
One 12 m truck type approximates the heavy fleet; ramp meter timing is unknown.
